title: 20 July 1961: Live: St John's Hall, Liverpool
content:
This was The Beatles’ fourth performance at St John’s Hall on Snaefell Avenue in Tuebrook, Liverpool.

Mona Best, mother of Pete and owner of the Casbah Coffee Club, also ran some nights at St John’s Hall. The venue shouldn’t be confused with a hall in Bootle of the same name where The Beatles also performed.

The Beatles played at Liverpool’s St John’s Hall on 11 occasions. The other dates were 17 February; 10 March; 13 and 27 July; 3, 10, 17, 24 and 31 August; and 8 September 1961.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

  • 2006: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Radio City Music Hall, New York City
  • 1992: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Belga Beach Festival, De la Panne
  • 1990: Paul McCartney live: Cleveland Stadium, Cleveland
  • 1987: Recording: Choba B CCCP by Paul McCartney
  • 1980: John Lennon writes Cleanup Time
  • 1974: Recording: Steel And Glass, Old Dirt Road by John Lennon
  • 1971: Filming: Imagine by John Lennon and Yoko Ono
  • 1969: The Beatles attend Let It Be screening
  • 1968: Jane Asher announces her split from Paul McCartney
  • 1967: The Chris Barber Band records Catcall
  • 1967: George Harrison and Ringo Starr travel to Greece
  • 1964: US single releases: And I Love Her, I’ll Cry Instead
  • 1964: US album release: Something New
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Ritz Ballroom, Rhyl
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Bell Hall, Warrington
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
